page_title: DAR 4-2 WER | Darmstadt v Werder Bremen 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) is given a yellow card.
90+3' The game has begun to heat up. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+2' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) swings it in and Justin Njinmah gets on the end of it, but Marcel Schuhen shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
87' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
86' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolai Rapp (Werder Bremen) replacing Christian Gross.
85' Substitution. Jens Stage leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
85' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) brings an opponent down and Martin Petersen interrupts the game.
84' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
84' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

83' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.

83' That's unlucky! Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
80' A substitution has been made. Fabian Nurnberger goes off and Frank Ronstadt (Darmstadt) comes on.
78' 4 - 2 Goal! Marvin Ducksch puts the ball across the area and Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 4:2.
78' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

78' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' The corner is swung in but Darmstadt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Darmstadt are awarded a corner kick.
75' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
74' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' The substitution has been made. Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) has replaced Marvin Mehlem.
71' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to substitute Fabian Holland and he is replaced by Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt).
70' 4 - 1 Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
69' Substitution. Romano Schmid did his best and is replaced by Naby Keita (Werder Bremen).
68' Martin Petersen interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt).
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Werder Bremen was in an offside position.
62' 4 - 0 Goal! Jiri Pavlenka gets a hand on the penalty from Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
62' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is going to take the penalty!
61' Referee Martin Petersen awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
61' Referee Martin Petersen makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Darmstadt. Let’s see what happens!
61' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
59' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) brought his opponent down.
59' Here is a change. Luca Pfeiffer is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) replaces Tim Skarke.
58' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

56' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Jiri Pavlenka easily makes the save.
52' A yellow-coloured card is received by Fabian Holland (Darmstadt).
50' 3 - 0 It's 3:0! Matthias Bader feeds Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
49' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the right post and ricochets away off it.
46' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Senne Lynen is replaced by Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
46' It is time for a substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is on for Rafael Borre.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Poor challenge! Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is penalised for tripping and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Darmstadt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
42' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
40' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
40' Martin Petersen has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt). Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
39' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick, but Marcel Schuhen reads it well and stops the effort.

39' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is out of play and Werder Bremen manage to earn a corner.
38' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Martin Petersen signals.
37' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
35' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
34' Martin Petersen blows the whistle, Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul.
33' Neat link-up play between Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) and Fabian Nurnberger, but Jiri Pavlenka reads the game well and the move breaks down.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

29' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Jiri Pavlenka pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
28' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Martin Petersen who sees an offensive foul.
25' 2 - 0 Amazing piece of skill! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is!
24' A pass by Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

23' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
23' It seemed like Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

22' Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Martin Petersen blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
21' Darmstadt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
19' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
18' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Christian Gross (Werder Bremen). Martin Petersen saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
17' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
17' Marcel Schuhen reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) towards the roof of the net.
16' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) was too forceful with his tackle and Martin Petersen interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
14' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) passes the ball onto Marvin Ducksch, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
10' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
10' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
10' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) tries to find Rafael Borre, but he puts too much power on the pass.
8' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' 1 - 0 What a hit! Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
